info.title: UniGate API
info.description: Vehicle hiring & management platform. Money is a decimal string; timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC; every response uses the same envelope.

TokenPair.description: null for WEB sessions — tokens travel in httpOnly cookies (ug_at / ug_rt)

accessToken.description: null in cookie mode (cookie was re-set)

Document.description: Metadata only — never the storage key or a URL.

CustomerCredit.description: outstandingAmount is computed from ledger_entries on read (30 s cache); never a stored column.

Dispatchability.description: fleet/vehicle.policy — approved + active + owner approved + mandatory documents verified & unexpired

vin.description: masked to the last 4 for anyone but the owner and staff

biddingOpen.description: deadline property, not a status — bids are accepted while true

redacted.description: true for the owner projection: instructions, contacts and street addresses withheld until an accepted bid

effectiveCommission.description: Shown to the bidding owner (when bidding.show_effective_commission_to_owners) and to staff; null for the customer

financial.description: Owner and staff projection; null for the customer

refund.description: Created only against a captured payment (Phase 9); null when nothing was paid

providerPaymentId.description: Gateway reference — never a token, never a PAN

allowedNextStatuses.description: From the vertical’s own transition map — render exactly these buttons

persisted.description: false = live position updated but not appended to history (sampled) — normal

phoneE164.description: Only for the booking’s customer while the trip is active

LedgerGroup.description: One balanced posting; debitTotal always equals creditTotal

InvoiceEinvoice.description: Never a cryptographic stamp, never credentials, never the raw authority response
